messages.subject: hyperparameters of gng model
parts:
Hi I am editing the gng models to take just two cues instead of four (specifically, Go to Win, NoGo to Avoid Losing). When looking at the stan files, the code says

// hyper parameters
  mu_pr[1]  ~ normal(0, 1.0);
  mu_pr[2]  ~ normal(0, 1.0);
  mu_pr[3]  ~ normal(0, 10.0);
  mu_pr[4]  ~ normal(0, 1.0);
  sigma[1:2] ~ normal(0, 0.2);
  sigma[3]   ~ cauchy(0, 1.0);
  sigma[4]   ~ normal(0, 0.2);

Should these be edited down to 2-vectors and if so does it matter that the 3rd sigma has a cauchy prior?

Many thanks,
Daniel

messages.author: 4bcf82a01cf98f56
messages.subject: Re: hyperparameters of gng model
parts:
Hi Daniel,

I somehow missed this message and sorry for the delayed reply. 

The short answer is 'no'. Here 1-4 refer to each of the four parameters in the model. So, even if the number of cues is 2 instead of 4, the four parameters remain the same.

Hope this helps!

Best,
Young
